- Venue raids: 75 arrested at villa June 2025.
- Pornography law: up to 7 years for content showing same-sex relations.
- Broadcasting ban, website/app bans, 2025 bill to prohibit online content.
- 94 documented cases of abuse against LGBT students (2026); officials call on parents to monitor children.
- Psychiatric association pathologized trans identities as mental illness, recommends rehabilitation.
- No anti-discrimination protections (though 2015 police circular, 2009 regulation on protecting minorities — issuance only, no outcomes).
- Subnational: Aceh Islamic criminal code with religious police caning "person with gender disorder"; 400+ religious bylaws; local rules in two cities used to fine trans women; national police refused to enforce local rules where conflicting; vigilante sweeps city-scoped.

Not quite the 0.15 anchors which involve regular street sweeps/convergence or armed militia controlling corridors, though the mob attacks + official framing + death in custody + extortion are severe.
